crossRefs.note: These are the children of Shobal: Alvan, Manahath, Ebal, Shepho, and Onam.
These are the children of Zibeon: Aiah and Anah. This is Anah who found the hot springs in the wilderness, as he fed…

people.name: Aiah
people.line: Son of Zibeon the Hivite, brother of Anah

people.name: Anah
people.line: Horite, father of Oholibamah, Esau's wife

people.name: Ebal
people.line: Son of Shobal and descendant of Seir the Horite

people.name: Shobal
people.line: Horite chief, son of Seir, in the land of Edom.
